clue.text: Succeed in being friendly

definitions.meaning: to make progress or do well in life
to have a good relationship with someone

explanation.walkthrough: The clue says '(3,2)' because the phrase splits as GET ON.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb covers both prospering in a career and having a harmonious relationship with others.

clue.text: Competent, in a perverse way, to make lists

indicators.note: perverse means twisted or contrary, so the letters are set in a contrary order

parts.note: the most competent person is the ablest

explanation.surface: A capable but contrary person still manages to draw up lists.
explanation.walkthrough: An indirect anagram: 'Competent' leads to ABLEST, and 'in a perverse way' rearranges it.
explanation.definitionFit: Tables are lists of figures or facts set out in rows and columns.

clue.text: You French need a decade, unfortunately in which to get trained!

indicators.note: suggests the letters have come out badly and need rearranging

parts.note: tu is the French word for you

explanation.surface: A French-speaking student needs ten years of schooling to become qualified.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unfortunately' shuffles TU (French for 'you') together with DECADE.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone educated has been schooled and taught, much as a trained person has been instructed.

clue.text: Very worried about where one should put the meat

definitions.text: where one should put the meat
definitions.meaning: a casserole of meat and vegetables simmered slowly

explanation.surface: Someone frets over the right place for the meat.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom for being anxious literally names a slow-cooked meat dish as the place for meat.

clue.text: A book which is not easily returned

definitions.text: A book which is not easily returned

parts.words: A book which is not easily returned
parts.note: read literally, a volume with a stiff spine that resists being handed back

explanation.surface: A borrowed book that the lender struggles to get back.
explanation.definitionFit: A book bound in stiff boards is described by its rigid rear cover.

clue.text: It's horrifying to have to write a couple of pages on every mixed gin!

parts.note: p is the abbreviation for page, so pp is pages
every one means all

indicators.note: a mixed drink has its ingredients jumbled together, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Writing two pages about every badly made gin cocktail would be dreadful.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mixed' rearranges GIN into ING at the end.
explanation.definitionFit: Something shocking and dreadful is horrifying.

clue.text: Concerning viewing

explanation.definitionFit: As a preposition it means about; as a verb it means looking at or considering.

clue.text: Managed to eat up somehow, although looking rather grey

indicators.note: says the letters are arranged in some other way

explanation.surface: Someone who managed to finish a meal still looks a bit pale.
explanation.walkthrough: 'somehow' rearranges EAT UP; 'Managed to' and 'although looking' are surface padding.
explanation.definitionFit: Taupe is a brownish-grey colour like moleskin.

clue.text: The idiot got left in a spot

indicators.note: says the letter goes inside the spot

parts.note: a dot is a small spot

explanation.surface: A fool ended up stranded in a tight situation.
explanation.definitionFit: A dolt is a stupid person, a dunce.

clue.text: Gathers together for prayers

definitions.meaning: short set prayers in church services

explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means assembles; as a plural noun it names short liturgical prayers.

clue.text: Gold share out resulted in a trial

parts.note: or is gold in heraldry
to deal is to distribute cards

explanation.surface: A dispute over dividing up gold ended in court.
explanation.walkthrough: 'trial' looks like a court case, but here it means a hardship.
explanation.definitionFit: An ordeal is a painful or testing experience, a severe trial.

clue.text: Doesn't live out of tins

indicators.note: says the letters come out of the word in a new order

explanation.surface: Nothing living can survive inside canned food.
explanation.definitionFit: To be means to exist, so the contraction for not existing serves for not living.

clue.text: Throwing net on the birds requires guts!

parts.note: rails are wading birds

explanation.surface: Casting a net over the birds takes courage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'guts' seems to mean courage, but it means intestines.
explanation.definitionFit: Entrails are the internal organs, especially the intestines.

clue.text: Look about, right and left, in a jaunty fashion

indicators.note: says the word for look goes around the other pieces

parts.note: to spy is to look
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone glances around, here and there, in a cheerful way.
explanation.definitionFit: Sprightly as an adverb means lively and brisk, with a jaunty spring.

clue.text: Extends the quiet study made in Sunday School

indicators.note: says the pieces are placed inside the outer letters

parts.note: SS is the abbreviation
p, piano, is the musical direction for quiet
to read a subject is to study it

explanation.surface: Quiet study at Sunday School lasts a long time.
explanation.definitionFit: To spread something is to stretch or extend it.

clue.text: Add one to 27 to make it grow much bigger

indicators.note: to make it here is to form a new arrangement from the combined letters

parts.note: an ace is the one in a pack of cards
the answer to 27 across, meaning a writing tablet

explanation.surface: Adding one to a number causes it to grow.
explanation.walkthrough: SLATE (27 across) plus ACE is rearranged; 'make' signals the reshaping.
explanation.definitionFit: To escalate is to increase rapidly in size or intensity.

clue.text: Changing the direction of the sewing, perhaps

definitions.meaning: turning a sailing boat across the wind

explanation.surface: A tailor's needle changing course as it stitches.
explanation.definitionFit: In sailing it is turning into the wind; in needlework it is loose basting stitches.

clue.text: Acceptance of the resolution of choice after receipt of publicity material

indicators.note: says the choice is placed after the advert

parts.note: an ad is an advertisement
an option is a choice

explanation.surface: A committee accepts a motion once the leaflets have arrived.
explanation.definitionFit: A motion's adoption is its formal acceptance by a meeting.

clue.text: Nastier mixed drink

indicators.note: a mixed drink has its parts jumbled, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A rather unpleasant cocktail.
explanation.definitionFit: Retsina is a Greek resinated white wine.

clue.text: Record pile upset by ardent fan

parts.note: a disc is a gramophone record

indicators.note: an upset pile is knocked over, its letters scattered

explanation.surface: A keen fan knocks over a stack of records.
explanation.definitionFit: A disciple is a devoted follower of a leader or cause.

clue.text: A spy discharges his obligations

parts.note: an agent settling his debts; the letters of the first two words also rearrange to give the solution

explanation.surface: An agent settles his debts.
explanation.definitionFit: To settle debts or obligations is to hand over money owed.

clue.text: Slow moving night fliers

indicators.note: a moving word shifts its letters into new places

explanation.surface: Birds flying slowly at night.
explanation.definitionFit: Owls are nocturnal birds of prey.

clue.text: Store fat to give to the queen

parts.note: lard is pig fat
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the Queen

explanation.surface: Keep fat aside to give to Her Majesty.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Store' looks like a verb, but it is a noun: a place for food.
explanation.definitionFit: A larder is a pantry where food is kept.

clue.text: There's a snake in charge of the jelly!

parts.note: the asp is an Egyptian snake

explanation.surface: A snake is supervising the dessert.
explanation.definitionFit: Aspic is a savoury jelly made from meat stock.

clue.text: Sounds like a country which is rather cold

indicators.note: says the word is identified by how it is spoken

parts.note: Chile is a South American country

explanation.surface: A nation with a chilly-sounding name.
explanation.definitionFit: Chilly means cool, unpleasantly cold.

clue.text: Ridicule twisting stairs, for example

indicators.note: twisting the letters puts them in a new order

parts.note: i.e. is the abbreviation for that is, used here as an example marker

explanation.surface: Mocking a spiral staircase, say.
explanation.definitionFit: To satirise is to mock with irony or exaggeration.

clue.text: Tear to pieces the makeshift black-board

definitions.meaning: a writing tablet of grey rock

explanation.definitionFit: It means to criticise severely and also a writing tablet used like a blackboard.

clue.text: One's in India-or somewhat further to the east!

indicators.note: says the first word goes inside the country

parts.note: taken as written
one's read as ones

explanation.surface: Someone is in India, or perhaps a little further east.
explanation.definitionFit: Indonesia lies to the south-east of India across the ocean.
